facts.text: The image is a composite creature-design reference sheet centered on one black dragon, with a large hero panel across the top and six smaller labeled detail panels arranged below in two rows.

In the top hero panel, the dragon stands or crouches low on rocky ground in a volcanic landscape, its head lowered toward the left, its wings partly spread, and its long spiked tail extending behind it.
The dragon has very dark charcoal-to-black scales, long pale bone-colored horns sweeping backward from the skull, a spiked crest along the head and spine, and a visible orange eye.
The dragon has large membranous bat-like wings with dark, weathered membrane, visible finger struts, and irregular trailing edges.
The dragon has four stout clawed limbs and a long tail edged with spikes.
The hero background shows jagged dark mountains, a dark reflective pool or wet ground, scattered glowing embers, and orange lava light under a smoky, dark sky.
The second row contains three full-body views labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "REAR".
The third row contains four close-up panels labeled "HEAD CLOSE", "WING MEMBRANE", "CLAW AND FOOT", and "SCALE DETAIL".
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's head in profile, emphasizing the long pale horns, textured dark scales, and an orange eye.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a close view of a translucent brownish membrane stretched between dark wing struts.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a dark scaled foot with several long, curved, pale claws.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with subtle blue-green iridescent highlights.
The smaller turnaround and detail panels are set against plain dark grey backgrounds, unlike the volcanic hero scene.
Lighting is low-key and dramatic: warm orange rim light and lava glow in the hero panel, with softer neutral light in the reference views and close-ups.
